name: Layout, hierarchy and ease of scanning
scope: Human reviewer can find sections, identify entries and distinguish headings from evidence. Order serves the target and career context.

anchors.0: Essential sections/entries difficult to locate or follow
anchors.3: Navigation usable but hierarchy or order inconsistent
anchors.5: Clear hierarchy, section order and entry grouping make relevant evidence easy to find

name: Typography and text legibility
scope: Body text, headings and dates are readable at normal viewing size and in the exported document; no font-prestige preference.

anchors.0: Material text illegible, extremely small or clipped
anchors.3: Generally readable with some difficult text
anchors.5: Comfortably readable body/headings/dates throughout the exported document

name: Spacing, alignment and information density
scope: Whitespace, alignment, line spacing and grouping avoid collisions and support comfortable reading.

anchors.0: Overlaps/crowding or alignment materially disrupt reading
anchors.3: Some crowded areas or inconsistent alignment
anchors.5: Balanced density, coherent alignment and clear grouping across pages

name: Visual consistency and professional coherence
scope: Heading, bullet, date and emphasis styles are coherent; purposeful variation accepted; decorations do not distract.

anchors.3: Some repeated style inconsistencies or distractions
anchors.5: Coherent styling and restrained emphasis support the target and content

name: Page length, flow and space utilization
scope: Length is proportionate to relevant evidence/instructions; page breaks, headings and text are not stranded, truncated or accidentally blank.

anchors.0: Severe truncation, broken flow or disproportionate compression/length
anchors.3: Usable flow with avoidable breaks, blanks or density imbalance
anchors.5: Length justified by evidence/context; clean page transitions and balanced space

name: Contrast, visual accessibility and meaningful graphics
scope: Important information is readable in colour/grayscale and not conveyed only by colour, icons, charts or skill bars.

anchors.0: Essential meaning lost through low contrast or unexplained visual-only elements
anchors.5: Readable contrast and text equivalents preserve all essential meaning
